response.sql: SELECT s.entrystat, AVG(e.ambictemp) AS avg_ambictemp, AVG(e.imgcount) AS avg_imgcount, AVG(e.imgcount) - (SELECT AVG(e2.imgcount) FROM scanenvironment e2 JOIN sites s2 ON s2.zoneregistry = e2.zoneref) AS diff_from_overall_avg_imgcount FROM scanenvironment e JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = e.zoneref GROUP BY s.entrystat

assumptions.assumption: The overall image-count average is the mean over all matched environment records, not the mean of the per-status averages. Because zoneref is NOT NULL with a foreign key to sites, it is the same as the mean over all environment records.
NULL ambictemp and imgcount values are ignored, which is AVG's default behavior. Records are not filtered on entrystat, so a site with a NULL entrystat would show up as its own NULL group.
